answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 99 identities per epoch. Audits are published in basalt, queued in voyage, and lagoon publishes the wait time. A farm of 33 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2461 identities would post 3448 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
